Abiding Savior Lutheran Church LCMC, Tucson Arizona - official site (served from its S3 endpoint)

notes: Very small LCMC (post-ELCA association) congregation on Tucson's south side; the LCMC directory gives average attendance of about 14. Address confirmed as 6000 S. Cardinal Ave, Tucson AZ 85746 by both the church's own site and the LCMC directory; the congregation shares a building with Faith Tabernacle Church, and Faith Tabernacle's name is the one on the road sign. Pastor: the church's own site says 'Pastor Cindy Bakko'; the LCMC directory lists her as Cynthia Bakko, Lead Pastor - the same person, recorded here under the name the church itself uses. WEBSITE CAVEAT: the domain abidingsaviorlutheranchurchlcmc.org no longer resolves in DNS; the site is only reachable through its raw S3 website endpoint, which is the URL recorded here. Its visible content was last updated around August 2025, so confirm the congregation is still active before doing a review. NO SERMON ARCHIVE FOUND: no YouTube channel, podcast, audio archive or posted sermon texts were located; the Facebook page is the only other outlet found and was not opened. Without a sermon corpus this church may not be reviewable - that is the main open question. Do not confuse this congregation with Abiding Savior Lutheran Church in Tempe AZ (abidingsaviorlutheran.church) or with Abiding Savior Free Lutheran, which also appears at a Cardinal Ave address in third-party directories. Coordinates not set - run tools/geocode.py.
